title: container-agent module
description: module.toml of a container-agent module: what the module needs and which processes it runs. Tools, apt packages and setup hooks live in the mise.toml next to it.

description.description: One line about what the module does. Shown by `container-agent modules` and in the configurator.

requires.description: Modules this module cannot work without. They are enabled automatically and set up first.

after.description: Modules to set up and start before this one, but only if they are enabled too. Use it for optional companions, e.g. the agents a UI drives.

arch.description: CPU architectures the module works on. Omit it if the module works on all of them.

next_steps.description: What to do after the first start, e.g. log in or pair an app. One step per item; commands in backticks run inside the container (configurators prefix them with `docker compose exec`).

env.description: Environment variables the module reads. Keys are variable names.

daemons.description: Long-running processes in pitchfork syntax (https://pitchfork.jdx.dev), checked against the schema of the pitchfork version in the image. They run as the agent user with the mise environment, start on boot and in the workspace unless `boot_start` or `dir` say otherwise.

default.description: Value used when the variable is not set in the container environment.

required.description: The container refuses to start when the variable is empty.

secret.description: The value is a password or token. Configurators keep it out of compose.yaml and in .env.

port.description: The variable holds a port the module listens on, and which protocol it speaks.
